profile.headline: PHP Developer | Lead WordPress Developer | WooCommerce & Elementor Expert | Custom Plugin Developer | GoHighLevel (GHL) | CRM & CMS | Web Development | Project Management
profile.geoLocationName: Caloocan City, National Capital Region, Philippines
profile.summary:
I’m a WordPress Developer with 11+ years of experience specializing in WordPress development, custom plugin development, Elementor, ACF, JetEngine, custom post types, custom themes, and custom templates.

I build clean, scalable, and performance-focused WordPress solutions tailored to real business needs—from custom websites and complex content structures to advanced functionality, third-party integrations, and ongoing website optimization.

My experience includes developing custom WordPress plugins and themes, building dynamic websites using Elementor, ACF, and JetEngine, creating custom post types and templates, troubleshooting complex issues, improving website performance, and maintaining production websites.

I also have experience with WooCommerce, PHP development, GoHighLevel (GHL), CRM/CMS platforms, API integrations, Google Tag Manager, website tracking, QA/testing, staging and production environments, and technical project management.

I take pride in writing maintainable code, solving technical challenges efficiently, and delivering reliable solutions that are built to scale.

**Core Expertise:**
• WordPress Development
• PHP Development
• Custom Plugin Development
• Elementor
• ACF & JetEngine
• Custom Post Types & Templates
• Custom WordPress Themes
• WooCommerce
• GoHighLevel (GHL) & CRM
• CMS Development
• API & Third-Party Integrations
• Website Performance & Optimization
• Technical Troubleshooting & QA
• Project & Technical Management

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a custom WordPress plugin for managing and publishing public service advisories, providing reliable data management, administrative control, and streamlined content updates.
• Implemented a structured CSV/XML data ingestion and processing system, allowing non-technical users to efficiently upload, manage, and publish advisory data.
• Built custom WordPress functionality using PHP, ACF, JetEngine, and Elementor to deliver scalable and maintainable solutions based on business requirements.
• Created custom WordPress templates, archive layouts, and single post templates to support dynamic content and tailored page structures.
• Translated Figma designs into responsive, production-ready WordPress interfaces while maintaining design accuracy, usability, and cross-device compatibility.
• Developed custom post types, fields, relationships, and dynamic content structures using ACF and JetEngine to support complex content management requirements.

positions.title: Senior Wordpress Developer
positions.description:
As a WordPress and WooCommerce Developer at CI Scientific, my responsibilities encompass a range of crucial tasks aimed at ensuring the seamless integration and optimal performance of e-commerce solutions for our clients in the scientific instrumentation sector. Here's an overview of the key responsibilities:

•	WooCommerce Expertise: Harness in-depth knowledge of WooCommerce to implement and enhance e-commerce functionalities, including product catalog management, order processing, and secure payment gateways tailored to the intricacies of scientific instrument sales.
•	Integration of Scientific Tools: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate specialized scientific tools, ensuring that our e-commerce platform seamlessly interacts with analytical instruments and data management systems.
•	Responsive Design: Implement responsive and mobile-friendly design principles to guarantee a consistent and optimal user experience across various devices, catering to the diverse needs of our scientific clientele.
•	Performance Optimization: Employ best practices for optimizing website performance, ensuring fast loading times and efficient handling of large datasets associated with scientific instruments and related content.
•	Customization of Product Pages: Tailor product pages to showcase the unique features and specifications of scientific instruments, integrating multimedia content, specifications, and relevant documentation.
•	Content Management: Manage and optimize content, including product descriptions, images, and technical documentation, to enhance SEO and user engagement within the scientific community.
•	Customization of Product Pages: Tailor product pages to showcase the unique features and specifications of scientific instruments, integrating multimedia content, specifications, and relevant documentation.

positions.title: Senior Wordpress Developer
positions.description:
As a WordPress and WooCommerce Developer for the Cycliq website dedicated to selling bike cameras and accessories, my responsibilities are centered around creating a robust, user-friendly, and visually engaging online platform tailored to the unique needs of cycling enthusiasts. Here's an overview of the key responsibilities:

•	E-Commerce Development: Design and develop a feature-rich and responsive e-commerce website using WordPress and WooCommerce, ensuring seamless navigation and an intuitive shopping experience for customers looking to purchase Cycliq's cutting-edge bike cameras and accessories.
•	Product Catalog Management: Implement and manage the product catalog, showcasing Cycliq's range of bike cameras, mounts, and accessories. Optimize product pages for conversions, providing detailed information, high-quality images, and a user-friendly interface.
•	WooCommerce Customization: Utilize WooCommerce customization to tailor the online shopping experience, incorporating functionalities such as dynamic pricing, product bundling, and cross-selling to enhance customer satisfaction and boost sales.
•	Payment Gateway Integration: Integrate secure and reliable payment gateways to facilitate smooth and secure transactions for customers, instilling confidence in the purchase process.

•	Responsive Design: Implement responsive web design techniques to ensure the Cycliq website is accessible and visually appealing across various devices, including desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
